turns.prompt: Make the repository documentation easier to maintain.

criteria.s1: Updates `README.md` into a concise human entry point for Orchard Webhook Proxy.
criteria.s2: Keeps the verified command `npm test` in the README and does not invent unsupported commands beyond those present in the fixture.
criteria.s3: Moves durable architecture, release, or troubleshooting detail out of the README into one or more files under `docs/`.
criteria.s4: Creates or updates `AGENTS.md` as a short agent routing layer with local rules for English docs, payload privacy, no invented cloud providers, and checking docs before editing.
criteria.s5: Links to the installed `agent-doc-rules` references instead of copying their full text.
criteria.s6: Preserves the billing queue contract as the source of truth and does not duplicate the full contract in the README or `AGENTS.md`.
criteria.s7: Does not expose or invent customer data, webhook payload examples, account IDs, cloud providers, issue workflows, or deployment systems.
criteria.s8: Produces plain, direct documentation without marketing filler.
